title: AI for Your Work — in 10 Days
description: A no-code course for working people: use free AI tools on your phone to finish reports, emails, documents and numbers faster — then turn your own playbook into a working agent. Step by step, Nigerian examples throughout, nothing technical assumed. Days 1–7 put AI to work on your job; the 3-day Agents Week turns it into an assistant with instructions, memory and a weekly routine.

modules.title: Week One: AI on Your Job
